title: DRIVE = FAHH
description: DRIVE = FAHH turns boating into an accidental unpredictable soundtrack. No scripting, no mods. Just a resource pack. Ice boating recommended!
body:
DRIVE = FAHH adds to the boat paddling sounds the custom audio of FAHH. No collision detection, no triggers - just the game sampling the paddle events at irregular intervals while you move, creating an unpredictable rhythm that speeds up, slows down and desyncs based on your speed and direction, all through a resource pack, maybe chaotic, maybe cursed, maybe useful.
Accidentally perfect.
